release_note.summary: About now lists all nineteen AI Tips and the first SE 401 video lab, while keeping the shared member platform and Studio inference in the proposed roadmap.
release_note.technical_summary: The generated About state was reconciled against production through releases #211 and #213. It discovers complete lesson surfaces in the checkout so recently published lessons cannot be hidden by a stale catalog count.

2026-11-21: The launch moved from a course outline to sixteen AI Tips, a complete ten-lesson SE 101 sequence and a book sample. Learners could watch in place and pick up where they stopped.
2026-11-22: People gained a way to contribute stories or take a copy of the project. Their AI assistants gained Markdown guides to the same pages, while editors gained a staging site for review.
2026-11-23: SE 201 connected its design and operating lessons with a worked feature. Learners could follow the decisions from the opening plan through verification.
2026-11-24: A complete course and a clearer editorial record
The final SE 201 recording completed the course. Video dates helped readers spot new material, while the public outline, policy and contributor credits made the book’s development easier to follow.
2026-11-25: The book acquired voices beyond its preview
Two nonfiction chapters, a guest contribution and a revised narrated preview gave readers several ways into the book. AI Tips also added a lesson on keeping secrets out of prompts.
2026-11-26: From a local playbook to a member-platform design

SE 301 opened its local AI playbook, while SE 401 defined a hosted-model build plan and a GitHub-only design for sponsored member applications. About documented possible nonprofit benefits and unresolved provider terms. Account-backed learning, safer paste-first guidance and stable/upcoming navigation improved the current site; the shared hosting service remained a proposal.
2026-11-27: Two beginner AI tips and two engineering labs

Learners can now size a model, start a local endpoint and save a reproducible baseline with the first SE 301 video lesson and install prompt. The homepage book card also links both released chapter previews: Building Blocks and Sick, Well, Fit. AI Tips 18 and 19 show how to catch a missing detail and review one example before expanding a job. SE 301 Video 1 tests a local model endpoint. SE 401 Video 1 uses a shift handoff to show how to check a model’s work.

2026-W47: A library people and their agents could use

The opening weekend established the learning experience. A visitor could finish SE 101, listen to a book preview and bring an assistant to read the same material. The contribution and copy paths opened the work to other builders.
2026-W48: From everyday AI practice to testing a model

SE 201 finished with an end-to-end capstone, SE 301 published a local-compute playbook and first runnable lesson, and SE 401 mapped a hosted-model build plan plus a proposed GitHub-only member platform. About now records possible nonprofit benefits and the provider limits that still need answers. The OpenBook offers two released chapter previews, while the site’s account and release tools remain the working examples learners can inspect today. AI Tips 18 and 19 show how to catch a missing detail and review one example before expanding a job. SE 301 Video 1 tests a local model endpoint. SE 401 Video 1 uses a shift handoff to show how to check a model’s work.

2026-11: Nineteen AI tips and the first SE 301 and SE 401 videos

November produced complete introductory and enterprise courses, nineteen AI Tips, two released OpenBook chapter previews, and a local-compute course whose first lesson can be run now. The contribution, account and release surfaces make the site itself a worked example. SE 401 and About describe a proposed sponsored member platform, while explicitly leaving shared hosting, provider adapters, funding awards and local inference as work to validate.
